authority: Main C8 work package authorizes feasible short real development learning after concrete budget/time notice; no long native-network training or query expansion.

input.context: Original tile-clipped7x7 patches; no new halo or graph. Same pixels are not matched ground area.

representations.input: Exact C6 bank raw_fp32 values before project minmax; author preprocessing already exists.
representations.learner_scope: Source-fit raw-descriptor reference; samplewise fixed transformation, no inherited weights or fitted population scaling. Task/ontology/role metadata already exposed; not an unqualified G2 confirmation.

representations.input: C7 frozen per-band devtrain minmax-normalized values; no C8 refit.
representations.learner_scope: Source-fit transfer with target-scene-statistics-exposed inference features, separately named; not strict source-only or a new TTA optimizer.

features.band_alignment: None. Same distributional functional over each delivered spectrum; no index resampling, certified wavelength equivalence, SRF integration or common physical band grid.
features.per_pixel: z=(spectrum-median)/IQR; IQR<=1e-12 gives a zero descriptor. Features:clip(-(q05-q50)/IQR,0,8)/8;clip((q95-q50)/IQR,0,8)/8;clip((q75+q25-2*q50)/IQR,-1,1);mean(clip(z,-4,4)^2)/16.
features.spatial: Concatenate4 center-pixel descriptors with4 arithmetic means over the49 patch pixels.
features.dtype: float64 feature/linear fitting, fixed analytic scaling, no dataset-fitted feature normalizer.

linear_model.loss: mean Bernoulli cross entropy +0.5*0.01*sum(w^2); intercept unpenalized
linear_model.initialization: numpy.default_rng(root_seed).normal(0,0.01,8), intercept0; identical initialization rule/hash across directions and representations.
linear_model.prediction: class1 iff logit>0; exact tie is class0
linear_model.selection: Fixed final update only; no validation-based selection, threshold calibration or stopping.

centroid_reference.source: Two scenes times two representations, no fake seed repetitions
centroid_reference.metric: Euclidean nearest class means from each scene's10 fitting points
centroid_reference.selection: Closed-form terminal fit, no validation tuning

execution_order: Separate source-stage processes may read source_fit arrays only; seal all source checkpoints. Target-stage processes may read target_adapt arrays and sealed source endpoints only. Freeze every registered endpoint before any source_development/target_development spectral read or metric. A C8 phase/file allowlist guards the reused C7/C6 reader.

statistics.per_model: OA,AA,macroF1,NLL,Brier,2x2 confusion and per-class denominators/recall; all10 development points,5 per class.
statistics.seed_summary: All3 fixed initializations, mean and sampleSD(ddof1); same points across seeds are not independent observations.
statistics.paired_point_comparisons: Within target and seed:source-fit transfer versus target-scratch64; adaptation versus scratch64 and128; raw versus legacy for the same endpoint. Report correct-to-wrong/wrong-to-correct and paired losses.
statistics.uncertainty: Exact enumeration of nonparametric original-parent cluster resamples with replacement, m^m ordered draws. Report2.5/97.5 percentile ranges as descriptive sensitivity only, not nominal coverage with2/3 clusters. Undefined class recall/AA in a draw is missing and its valid-draw count is reported.
statistics.direction_difference: Different target point sets, not point-paired causal sensor evidence. Cross-product of observed-parent resamples for descriptive directional sensitivity; model-seed spread is initialization variation only.
statistics.forbidden: No target-dev winner selection, p-value claims of independent sensor replication, or multiplying sample count by seeds/arms.

strict_protocols_not_claimed: Pristine full-pipeline G2 confirmation on an untouched target family
Canonical publisher-byte reproduction of local derived MAT
private_artifact_policy: Real weights/features/raw point IDs and HMAC pseudonymization key stay on Linux. Export aggregate and opaque-point paired tables without coordinate/ID recovery material.
recovery: Verify all snapshot bytes and source, reload sealed parameters/features, reproduce all evaluation outputs; no extra fitting updates in recovery.
